title: Voter Identification Regulations 2022
amendmentMotionNotes: Baroness Pinnock moved, as an amendment to the motion in the name of Baroness Scott of Bybrook, to leave out from “that” to the end and insert “this House declines to approve the draft Voter Identification Regulations 2022 as they will prevent legitimate electors from voting in elections and disproportionately affect disadvantaged groups”. The House divided:

notContents.name: The Lord Bishop of St Albans
